Params: {1: 'KURONO VESSEL, DECK', 2: 'NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY'}
{2: 'LOCATION: KURONO VESSEL, DECK. NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY.'}
{3: 'The sky is a churning mass of black clouds. Wind and rain tear across the deck. '}
{3: 'Even with stabilizers working at full capacity, the ship cannot stop itself from rolling with the angry sea.', 22: '1'}

{3: 'Across the wet steel, Kurono soldiers drag crates of ammunition and equipment into position. Some throw themselves into fortifying the perimeter. Others lean over the rails, pouring fire into the Corrupted that rush across the waves toward them.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurono Squad Leader', 3: 'Keep firing! Do not let them reach us!', 4: '3'}
{3: 'The close-range comms are nearly useless against the howl of the storm. The commander has to scream his orders, and every shouted syllable winds the soldiers tighter.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Unnoticed in the chaos, the Corrupted have curved around the ship in a half-moon formation, probing the defensive line for any weakness.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The machines leading the charge are low-grade, cheap enough that a single magazine can put one down. But the guns are not the problem. The problem is the math. There are always more.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crew Member A', 3: "We're losing ground! First perimeter's been breached!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurono Squad Leader', 3: "What do you mean you're losing ground?! Get the cargo crew armed!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: "Everyone hold position! And don't you dare throw out orders like that!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'Someone else will handle anything that breaks through. Abyss Passer!', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Without warning, dozens of white trails cut through the water from directly below the ship. They streak toward the Corrupted and slam into them with brutal precision. Spikes punch through metal bodies, and the impacts ripple outward in a chain of detonations.'}
{3: 'The line that holds the enemy back is not gunfire. It is the Symbiotic Sirens, the machines they hauled up from the deep not long ago.'}
{3: "In the wake of the Sirens' attack, the sea where the Corrupted mass begins to twist and heave. Globes surface one by one, bobbing among the enemies."}

{3: 'They belong to Moses, its gravitational field manipulators. A few short flashes serve as the only warning. Then the devices trigger all at once. Whirlpools spin into being, and the water surface collapses inward, dragging the Corrupted down.'}
{3: 'One by one, the Corrupted go limp under the relentless assault and slip silently into the deep. Clausen breaks into an excited grin.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: "Yes! That's it! I knew this job was worth it. We clean up this mess, and I'm looking at a promotion and a very comfortable future!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: 'Hey! Those Millennium Project mechanoids have the sea covered. The rest of you, find someone and get my ship back under control!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crew Member B', 3: "Captain, we've got another situation!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crew Member B', 3: "Ship's energy reserves have dropped below 20%. After Cpu0 seized control, it's been using its drones to siphon our power nonstop!", 4: '1'}

{3: "The shock on Clausen's face shifts into something else, a sudden realization snapping into place. He throws himself against the deck railing and leans far out over the water, ignoring every instinct that screams danger."}

{3: 'The Sirens. The Moses devices. All of them carry clusters of small fish-shaped drones latched onto their frames. It matches exactly what Adelyde told him, that Cpu0 was built to service the other nodes.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'Abyss Passer! Are you using my ship as a damn battery?!', 4: '1'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: "Apolo... gies... All nodes' energy reserves have entered the critical threshold. Initiating proximity extraction protocol."}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: "Don't you dare go all robot on me now with that nonsense! Adelyde! How many more times are you going to screw me over?! If this ship—", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Clausen sweeps his gaze across the deck. Hurrying soldiers and driving rain fill his vision, but the one color he loathes, that infuriating red, is utterly absent.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'Abyss Passer! Answer me! Where is she?!', 4: '1'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: 'Adely... "Helio" is executing the contingency plan as scheduled. Agreed timeframe: within ten minutes.'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: 'I told you to drop the machine act! You were plenty chatty a second ago!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'INSIDE THE NETHERWEB DATA CENTER', 2: 'NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY, DEPTH: 600 METERS', 4: 'SOMETIME EARLIER'}
{2: 'SOMETIME EARLIER. LOCATION: INSIDE THE NETHERWEB DATA CENTER. NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY. DEPTH: 600 METERS.'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: '"Helio", are you saying someone noticed the explosions at Netherweb\'s branch server rooms?'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Yeah. When I got here, I received a message ordering me to rendezvous with Kurono's people. They know I'm in the area, and they've probably figured out about the explosions too.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "My guess is... whoever's coming isn't just here to extract me. They're here to collect you as well.", 4: '2'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: 'Will they let us continue the project?'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: 'Then nothing\'s changed. "Helio", we can find a suitable position nearby, establish a defensive line, and intercept the Corrupted.'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "I've seen what shape you're all in on my way here. Never mind frame integrity, you're barely running on fumes. Can you really pull that off?", 4: '2'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: 'We have everything Cpu0 has stockpiled. And we can draw energy from the ship coming for you.'}

{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: 'The calculations say otherwise. "Helio", I\'m going to begin gradually shutting down my non-essential cognitive modules. The energy that was sustaining them can be redirected to frame operations.'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: 'That will be enough to see us through the battle ahead.'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: "It means I won't be able to have pleasant conversations like this with you anymore."}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: "But becoming a little less intelligent, reverting to what we were before, won't compromise our mechanical performance."}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: "We didn't awaken for the sake of freedom or selfhood. We awakened so we could carry this project through."}

{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: 'Free thought and consciousness itself were simply tools we needed to overcome the situation we faced back then. And if those tools can now help you overcome this new challenge, "Helio", if they can keep the project alive...'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: "Then it means we have done the right thing. That our time wasn't wasted."}
{1: 'KURONO VESSEL, DECK', 2: 'NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY'}
{2: 'LOCATION: KURONO VESSEL, DECK. NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY.'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: 'Gravitational field system damage rate exceeded 80%. Shutdown imminent.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurono Squad Leader', 3: 'Pour grenades straight down! Just keep them off us!', 4: '1'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: 'Netherweb centralized computing cluster: threshold exceeded. Siren units remaining: forty.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crew Member C', 3: "They're boarding port side! Where's the Construct squad?! Push that garbage back into the sea!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The battle churns like a maelstrom, both sides grinding against each other without mercy. Radar signatures flicker and die in clusters.'}
{3: 'Shells slam into the waves, and underwater detonations hurl white spray into the air. The frantic pounding of boots on steel mingles with the cold monotone of system alerts.'}
{1: '1', 3: "All of it braids together into a single maddening roar that presses against Clausen's skull."}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: "The fight's still going, but the Abyss Passer's getting stupider by the second. Hey, answer me! What the hell is wrong with you?!", 4: '1'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: 'Netherweb emergency modifications complete. Commencing interference with Corrupted hive consciousness via abandoned fiber optic network.'}

{3: "Through the continuous exchange of fire, Clausen realizes the Abyss Passer's voice has hollowed out. Only clipped, procedural replies remain, stripped of everything but cold efficiency. As a Kurono officer, he knows this pattern."}
{3: 'He shoves the memories back down where they came from. Scrap metal deserves no grief. The one thing Clausen will not tolerate is a plan that mutates beyond his grasp.'}
{3: 'He joins the defensive line with fury in his throat, spitting curses at the high command that handed him this nightmare, at Adelyde, at every face he can summon from his rage.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crew Member B', 3: "Captain! Good news, at the northern node behind our route... Gray Raven's made progress there. Comms protocol modifications are nearly complete!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'That just pisses me off even more!', 4: '1'}
{3: "Relief and fury war across Clausen's face, the red of his anger only deepening. He brings his standard-issue greatsword around in a heavy arc and bats a Corrupted clean off the deck."}

{1: '1', 2: 'Crew Member B', 3: 'Yes sir! The Millennium Project machines are dragging the Corrupted down with them in suicide blasts. Once the northern node operation wraps up, the enemy should have no reason to keep hitting us—', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crew Member D', 3: 'Contact starboard! Looks the size of the ship!', 4: '1'}

{3: "The shouts all converge on a single point. A towering white wave is bearing down on them, and beneath the foam, something massive and dark moves with terrible purpose. Clausen can't tell the model, but he knows a corrupted war machine when he sees one."}
{3: 'It carves through the battlefield without slowing, smashing aside allied Corrupted units and Millennium machines alike and dragging their wreckage in its churn.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurono Squad Leader', 3: 'Captain! What do we do?!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'No escape. No way to fight it.', 3: '55', 4: 'ff4e4eff'}
{2: 'No escape. No way to fight it.'}
{3: "That is Clausen's conclusion. The enemy still has some distance to cover, but even at full throttle, there is no way his ship can outrun that Corrupted."}
{3: "This is clearly the enemy's ace in the hole, lying in wait all this time and ready to ambush the northern node. Which means if they can take it down, this battle is over."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'Easier said than done. This ship was never built to handle something like that!', 4: '1'}

{3: "His ship has nothing left that can hurt this thing. The Millennium Project's mechanoids are equally spent. Clausen does not need to run the numbers. He can feel it in his bones. The sea is about to swallow them whole."}
{3: 'The cabin door opens, and a figure in red steps out. Every crew member about to flee freezes where they stand. For one strange moment, even the chaos itself seems to pause.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'Adelyde, you... Wait, what the hell is that on your back...?', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: "It is Adelyde. She has been gone since the first shots rang out, and now she stands before him. The question dies in Clausen's throat as his eyes drop to the weapon mounted on her back."}

{3: 'He knows it. He took it from her himself. A cross-shaped heavy firearm wrapped in red and black armor that matches the design of her outfit. The engravings along its frame speak of age and lineage.'}
{3: 'Its weight, requiring a few Constructs just to lift it, and the complex mechanisms hidden beneath the cross make it clear this is no ordinary armament.'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Captain, a word of advice: next time, don't stash confiscated gear in the back room. Took me far too long to track it down.", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'You—I never authorized you to arm yourself!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "In combat operations, I don't need your authorization. Passer, can you draw the enemy's attention?", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'Adelyde! What the hell are you planning now?!', 4: '1'}

{3: 'The storm gives no ground, and the towering white wave still drives toward them without mercy. Adelyde moves past Clausen and his crew without a word, stopping only when she reaches the very edge of the deck.'}

{1: '1', 3: "Below her, the sea has become a graveyard of metal. Broken frames from both sides drift in slicks of leaking oil, the water's dark surface now stained nearly black. A signal pulses from the Abyss Passer, and the remaining machines answer. They throw themselves at the oncoming wave in one last assault."}
{3: 'They will herd the white wave right to her. Adelyde does not question it. Her hand closes around the cross, and she lifts it with a single arm as if it weighs nothing at all.'}

{3: "It feels like both judgment and salvation. Before the gathered eyes of the crew, the engine buried within the cross awakens. The red charging light flickers on, and the weapon's frame begins to shift."}
{3: 'Adelyde sweeps it around in a single, forceful arc and levels the revealed muzzle toward the oncoming breaker.'}

{3: 'Clausen understood from the first moment he saw it that this was no standard-issue firearm. He cannot guess how much devastation it can unleash. What he does know, with absolute certainty, is that anyone fool enough to stand behind it when it fires is going to be hurled into the ocean.'}

{3: "Clausen and the crew throw themselves behind whatever cover they can find. Adelyde's voice begins counting down while the engine's whine climbs higher and higher. Two brilliant targeting lines lance out from the weapon's sides, marking the kill zone for everyone to see."}

{3: 'The Corrupted beneath the white wave is close enough to see in full now. Its body traces the outline of a fish, yet nothing about it resembles anything natural. Whatever bionic form it once possessed has been erased and rebuilt into a nightmare of random parts and twisted wreckage.'}
{3: 'The remaining Sirens crash into the wave and knock the thing off its course. It dives, slipping beneath the surface, and in that single suspended moment, the entire world goes quiet.'}
{3: "The weapon's charge peaks. Clausen bellows at her to shoot, but Adelyde ignores him. She angles the massive cannon higher, resetting the trajectory away from the water."}
{3: "The sea explodes just off the ship's flank. The vessel heaves sideways as a wall of water slams onto the deck, washing over everything."}
{1: '1', 3: 'High above, the Corrupted twists in the air, repositioning for a killing drop that will send the ship straight to the bottom of the ocean. But...'}

{3: "The wave itself comes apart. Steam bursts from within, and through the collapsing spray, a red streak emerges. Twin targeting lasers slice through the mist and find their mark on the creature's skull."}
{3: "The trigger breaks. At the cross's tip, energy collapses inward for a single heartbeat, then releases. A column of white annihilation screams from the barrel."}
{3: 'It swallows the Corrupted whole without warning, and the beam does not stop. It climbs and climbs until it tears a hole straight through the storm clouds above.'}
{3: 'Something charred and smoking, the remains of a tail, tumbles out of the sky and hits the sea with a sickening splash. The crew stands frozen, staring at the steaming wreckage.'}
{3: 'Adelyde is already walking away. Overhead, the clouds begin to creep back together, closing the wound of sunlight before anyone can remember what it felt like.'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: "All Millennium Project nodes' damage rate has exceeded acceptable thresholds. All functions will be disabled shortly."}

{3: "The Abyss Passer's automated voice cuts through the silence and pulls every gaze back to the present. Clausen watches the red lockdown markers on the ship's console blink out, one after another. The vessel is coming back to him."}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: "This unit, designated Abyss Passer, has less than 1% power remaining. Unable to execute complete uplink backup protocol. Awaiting project manager's directive."}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: 'Please specify which data requires backup.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: "Backup? Isn't it obvious?! The Sirens, the Moses device... all of it! Send me the production data on every node's machinery, and you, too! I want full technical dossiers! The core files!", 4: '1'}

{3: "Clausen's eyes light up immediately. He had thought this whole venture would be a total loss, with all the ammo they had burned through, with the ship too damaged for the next operation, even arriving at the rendezvous point far behind schedule."}

{3: 'But none of it matters now. If he can walk away with every technical blueprint the Millennium Project has to offer, his standing is safe. Kurono only cares about one thing. Results. The path you take to get there is your own problem.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'No. Back up every dive log, every observation, and every dossier on the deep-sea research.', 4: '11'}
{1: '1', 3: "By the time anyone registers Adelyde's location, she's already inside the bridge. Every operator in there is on the floor."}
{1: '1', 3: "The bridge door seals with a sharp hiss under Adelyde's hand. Clausen has no choice but to press his face against the observation window, his crew crowding in behind him."}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: "This is my ship! This is outright trespassing, Adelyde! After everything you've pulled, now you want to back up research data?!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: 'Have you lost your f***ing mind?! Do you have any idea how much military strength we could gain from this f***ing deep-sea development data—', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "That would be Kurono's strength. Not ours.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "I won't let the Millennium Project become a bargaining chip in your power games.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'The Abyss Passer accepts the order and starts compiling the deep-sea research archive. A short countdown flashes across the control room screens, and then the transfer bar begins to fill.'}

{3: "Outside, Clausen and his crew are already trying to break through the window, but Kurono's ships are no cheap toys. When their weapons prove useless, he can only bark orders at his men to find emergency breach tools."}
{3: 'But the moment he sends them away, it is already too late. Clausen has lost any chance of stopping what comes next.'}
{1: '1', 3: "The noise outside fades to nothing in Adelyde's ears. She lowers the cross from her shoulder and fixes her eyes on the progress bar crawling across the screen."}
{3: 'It is as if she is looking straight through the hull, through the water, into the lightless deep where the Abyss Passer waits, a presence she has never seen but knows is there.'}
{3: 'The transmission carries no words. Only a low, agonized groan of metal buckling under impossible weight.'}
{3: 'The Abyss Passer has poured every last watt of power into the data transfer. Its station-keeping is gone now, and the abyss is calling it home.'}
{3: 'There is no fighting the depths that wait below. There is no fighting the empty tanks. Both ends meet at once.'}

{1: '1', 3: 'The prompt on the screen reads like a farewell. Adelyde can see the link between the Abyss Passer and the terminal thinning, the signal pulsing in fading waves. She lifts her hand to her chest and holds a formal salute.'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'I am Adelyde Helio, acting Project Manager of the Millennium Project. What follows is the final mission report.', 4: '1'}

{3: 'She recalls the lessons from her time at F.O.S., the lectures and protocols drilled into her. This is not a project lab, and there is no team of researchers beside her, but she stands tall anyway, her voice clear and steady, as she speaks.'}

{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'The Millennium Project has been underway for over a decade since its launch. Everyone here has witnessed the results achieved in that time and the perseverance each member has shown.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Human or machine, everyone who was part of this project, I hope you take pride in this remarkable achievement.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'I congratulate every single member of this project.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'This was a mission unlike any other. It was something truly extraordinary.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'An extraordinary central intelligence with four distinct nodes, and behind them, a brilliant team who set aside their family allegiances to pursue research together.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "It's unfortunate that we never reached our original goal. We never made it to the place where life began.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'But we proved what we were capable of. Every individual in this project did it justice.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'And now... I hereby declare the conclusion of the Millennium Project.', 4: '1'}
{2: '"Abyss Passer"', 3: 'Moses, offline. Symbiotic Sirens, offline. Cpu0, offline. Netherweb, offline.'}
{3: "The bar fills to 100%. The Millennium Project's complete research archive materializes on the screen before Adelyde. Then the comms collapse into a shrill, toneless shriek."}
{3: 'Beneath that noise, Adelyde catches something else. Applause, faint and scattered.'}

{1: '1', 3: 'Around her, in the edges of her vision, figures gather. They move past her in a blur, shaking hands, pulling each other into embraces. The scene rushes by too fast to hold, like a current slipping through her fingers, like rushing passers.'}
{3: 'Adelyde remains at attention, her salute unwavering.'}
{3: 'The comm line stays open. Even as the door splinters and Clausen and his crew come crashing through, she does not lower her hand.'}
